chapter: Metronome, Billie Holiday, Cleveland and Atlantic
title: Cleveland and the young players he helped start
summary: In Cleveland he got Sonny Payne, Ray Bryant and Red Prysock out on the road, and hired Screamin' Jay Hawkins.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: Cleveland Ohio. I went there for two weeks, stayed 2 years. And I discovered quite a few fellas, you know... Sonny Payne, I had to ask his mother, could he come out on the road, after I found out he could play. And his father was in

Chis Columbo down in Atlantic City. And they let him go out. I had to ask another fella's mother could he go out, Ray Bryant, but I heard him play, and said this cat sure could play -- young kid, you know, he couldn't go, so I had to ask his mother could he go. She ok'd it. Red Prysock had just got out of the army or navy or somethin', and... But those are some of the fellas that I helped get started in a way of speakin'. Screamin' Jay Hawkins had just got out of the airforce, I believe -- or navy or somethin'. And he kept askin' me for a job -- I didn't have no room for another fella, but he could sing the blues and he was a good, you know, good salesman.
Did you make any records with him?
